note: Documentation examples that boot the machine they describe. Each record names the profile, the payload and its identity, the entry the payload is loaded under, the console script, the exact expected transcript, and a cycle bound. tools/example_replay.py replays every one headlessly and requires exact agreement; it also requires each example's command to still appear in the document that shows it, so an example cannot drift from the text around it.
